geometry.image: Full-window contain-fit, no allocation reserved for controls
geometry.top: Session identity and close over a contrast-protecting scrim
geometry.bottom: Status, stop and 32px resize grip over a contrast-protecting scrim

native.decoration: No window border, rounding, shadow, title bar or allocated footer

interaction.move: Drag non-control image content using GtkWindowHandle
interaction.resize: Drag southeast grip; compositor move/resize shortcuts remain available
interaction.stop: Disable source hyprhand input without closing applications
interaction.keyboard: Focusable close/stop with explicit visible outline
interaction.controls: Image only at rest; reveal all chrome on whole-window hover or Tab navigation; pointer crossing and deactivation reset keyboard reveal

native.typography: Native font family, 12px labels; bounded text with full tooltips
native.freshness: Unchanged protocol age checks and stale-image clearing
